facts.text: It was controlled by the Techno Union, whose headquarters was the city of Purkoll.

evidence.quote: It was controlled by the Techno Union, whose headquarters was the city of Purkoll.

facts.text: Despite the Techno Union's ostensible neutrality, Skako Minor was captured by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, and its successor, the Galactic Empire, maintained the occupation into the Galactic Civil War.

evidence.quote: Despite the Techno Union's ostensible neutrality, Skako Minor was captured by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, and its successor, the Galactic Empire, maintained the occupation into the Galactic Civil War.

facts.text: A temperate world, the planet Skako Minor's misty surface featured canyons, mountains, caverns, craters, and fungal forests.

evidence.quote: A temperate world, the planet Skako Minor's misty surface featured canyons, mountains, caverns, craters, and fungal forests.

facts.text: It had an atmosphere of hydrogen sulphide that allowed Skakoans to live without their pressure suits.

evidence.quote: It had an atmosphere of hydrogen sulphide that allowed Skakoans to live without their pressure suits.

facts.text: Native fauna included the large, flying reptiles known as keeradaks.

evidence.quote: Native fauna included the large, flying reptiles known as keeradaks.

facts.text: At some point, industrialist Skakoans native to the nearby planet of Skako traveled to Skako Minor, and eventually the headquarters of the Techno Union conglomerate were moved to the world after it became predominantly controlled by members of the species.

evidence.quote: At some point, industrialist Skakoans native to the nearby planet of Skako traveled to Skako Minor, and eventually the headquarters of the Techno Union conglomerate were moved to the world after it became predominantly controlled by members of the species.

facts.text: During the Separatist Crisis, the Union's Foreman, Wat Tambor, aligned the Techno Union with the cause of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, an alliance of disenchanted star systems led by the charismatic Count Dooku.

evidence.quote: During the Separatist Crisis, the Union's Foreman, Wat Tambor, aligned the Techno Union with the cause of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, an alliance of disenchanted star systems led by the charismatic Count Dooku.

facts.text: The Union remained officially neutral, but supported the Separatists' military efforts during the Clone Wars, including holding the captured Republic ARC trooper Echo in a Techno Union facility in the Skako Minor settlement of Purkoll, allowing the Confederacy to exploit a Republic strategy algor...

evidence.quote: The Union remained officially neutral, but supported the Separatists' military efforts during the Clone Wars, including holding the captured Republic ARC trooper Echo in a Techno Union facility in the Skako Minor settlement of Purkoll, allowing the Confederacy to exploit a Republic strategy algorith

facts.text: During the war, Skako Minor was one of the Confederacy's factory worlds.

evidence.quote: During the war, Skako Minor was one of the Confederacy's factory worlds.

facts.text: In the last year of the war, a Republic incursion would violate the planet's corporate neutrality and free Echo.

evidence.quote: In the last year of the war, a Republic incursion would violate the planet's corporate neutrality and free Echo.

facts.text: Skako Minor was mentioned as a notable factory world by Muzzle in the survival compendium "Neyo's Almanac of Clankers." At the end of the Clone Wars, Darth Vader killed Wat Tambor.

evidence.quote: Skako Minor was mentioned as a notable factory world by Muzzle in the survival compendium "Neyo's Almanac of Clankers." At the end of the Clone Wars, Darth Vader killed Wat Tambor.

facts.text: At some point later, Vader embarked on a Mission to Skako Minor, executing all of Tambor's loyalists by massacring the Ruling Council and installing a new regime loyal to the Galactic Empire in its place.

evidence.quote: At some point later, Vader embarked on a Mission to Skako Minor, executing all of Tambor's loyalists by massacring the Ruling Council and installing a new regime loyal to the Galactic Empire in its place.

facts.text: After the war, the Techno Union was known to have been dissolved, and Skako Minor came under occupation by the Galactic Empire, the successor state to the Republic.

evidence.quote: After the war, the Techno Union was known to have been dissolved, and Skako Minor came under occupation by the Galactic Empire, the successor state to the Republic.

facts.text: Skakoans who protested Imperial rule were exiled from the planet, making life difficult for them as they ran out of the world's special air in their pressure suits.

evidence.quote: Skakoans who protested Imperial rule were exiled from the planet, making life difficult for them as they ran out of the world's special air in their pressure suits.

facts.text: Despite the fall of the CIS and the Techno Union, Echo—who, like most members of Clone Force 99, had abandoned the Imperial Military—suspected that he would still be trapped within the Techno Union headquarters on Skako Minor if he had never been rescued.

evidence.quote: Despite the fall of the CIS and the Techno Union, Echo—who, like most members of Clone Force 99, had abandoned the Imperial Military—suspected that he would still be trapped within the Techno Union headquarters on Skako Minor if he had never been rescued.

facts.text: He stated as such on the planet Daro, using Clone Force 99's experience rescuing him as a reason to extract former clone commando Gregor from an Imperial training center.

evidence.quote: He stated as such on the planet Daro, using Clone Force 99's experience rescuing him as a reason to extract former clone commando Gregor from an Imperial training center.

facts.text: He enlisted pirates to blockade the planet and stockpile technology, but many innocents came to suffer due to his actions.

evidence.quote: He enlisted pirates to blockade the planet and stockpile technology, but many innocents came to suffer due to his actions.

facts.text: After pirates attacked Skakoan refugees the world of Brentaal IV, Jul himself claimed to have no links to, at least, those pirates, claiming they were a third party taking advantage of a noble war, which he maintained was being fought for his oppressed people.

evidence.quote: After pirates attacked Skakoan refugees the world of Brentaal IV, Jul himself claimed to have no links to, at least, those pirates, claiming they were a third party taking advantage of a noble war, which he maintained was being fought for his oppressed people.

facts.text: The rescue mission of Echo would prove to be a turning point for at least one tribe of Poletecs, who fought alongside Republic forces and promised their continued support should the Jedi ever need to return.

evidence.quote: The rescue mission of Echo would prove to be a turning point for at least one tribe of Poletecs, who fought alongside Republic forces and promised their continued support should the Jedi ever need to return.

facts.text: The Techno Union built their headquarters, the city of Purkoll, on Skako Minor, nearby a Poletec village.

evidence.quote: The Techno Union built their headquarters, the city of Purkoll, on Skako Minor, nearby a Poletec village.

facts.text: Skako Minor was created for "The Bad Batch" arc of the Star Wars: The Clone Wars television show, first being mentioned in the episode "The Bad Batch" and then appearing for the first time in the episode "A Distant Echo." The episodes were first aired as unfinished production reels in 2015.

evidence.quote: Skako Minor was created for "The Bad Batch" arc of the Star Wars: The Clone Wars television show, first being mentioned in the episode "The Bad Batch" and then appearing for the first time in the episode "A Distant Echo." The episodes were first aired as unfinished production reels in 2015.

facts.text: During the episodes, several characters refer to Skako Minor as just Skako, but the 2018 roleplaying supplement Fully Operational established that the two were separate worlds.

evidence.quote: During the episodes, several characters refer to Skako Minor as just Skako, but the 2018 roleplaying supplement Fully Operational established that the two were separate worlds.

facts.text: The trivia gallery for "A Distant Echo" also erroneously referred to Skako Minor as "home of the Skakoan people" instead of Skako.

evidence.quote: The trivia gallery for "A Distant Echo" also erroneously referred to Skako Minor as "home of the Skakoan people" instead of Skako.

facts.text: A Poletec village was located near the city of Purkoll on the planet Skako Minor during the Clone Wars. Those living in the village were led by a Poletec chief.

evidence.quote: A Poletec village was located near the city of Purkoll on the planet Skako Minor during the Clone Wars. Those living in the village were led by a Poletec chief.

facts.text: Purkoll was a city located on the planet Skako Minor that served as the headquarters of the Techno Union. The facility had D1-series aerial battle droids and octuptarra magna tri-droids guarding it.

evidence.quote: Purkoll was a city located on the planet Skako Minor that served as the headquarters of the Techno Union. The facility had D1-series aerial battle droids and octuptarra magna tri-droids guarding it.

details.affiliation: Techno Union, Confederacy of Independent Systems (secretly)

facts.text: A workshop was owned by Wat Tambor of the Techno Union on the planet Skako Minor. It was visited by archeologist Chelli Lona Aphra and her crew.

evidence.quote: A workshop was owned by Wat Tambor of the Techno Union on the planet Skako Minor. It was visited by archeologist Chelli Lona Aphra and her crew.

facts.text: After the Clone Wars and the fall of the Techno Union, the Galactic Empire occupied the planet of Skako Minor, which had served as the Union's headquarters.

evidence.quote: After the Clone Wars and the fall of the Techno Union, the Galactic Empire occupied the planet of Skako Minor, which had served as the Union's headquarters.

facts.text: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, amid both the Galactic Civil War and Crimson Dawn's war against the Sith, the Skakoan nationalist Jul Tambor led an uprising on Skako Minor, also known as Jul Tambor's Insurgency, to reclaim the planet Skako Minor from a regime loyal to the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, amid both the Galactic Civil War and Crimson Dawn's war against the Sith, the Skakoan nationalist Jul Tambor led an uprising on Skako Minor, also known as Jul Tambor's Insurgency, to reclaim the planet Skako Minor from a regime loyal to the Galactic Empire.
